query_analysis.original_query: We need to develop a robust fault detection and diagnostic strategy for our continuous countercurrent extraction system. What machine learning approaches could enhance our predictive maintenance?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate and recommend appropriate machine learning techniques to develop a robust fault detection and diagnostic strategy for our continuous countercurrent extraction system, aiming to improve predictive maintenance and reduce downtime.

selected_agents.role: Develop fault detection and diagnostic strategy
Integrate predictive maintenance into process operations

communication_strategy.information_flow: Machine learning model development and integration into process control strategy
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative development and validation cycles between control strategy and machine learning implementation

clarification_questions: Do you have historical operational data available for training machine learning models?
What specific types of faults are of most concern in your extraction system?
Are there constraints on implementation platforms or preferred machine learning frameworks?
